request.text: Check the weather in Hangzhou for our class field trip on September 4, 2026, then give me a short packing checklist tailored to that forecast.

responsibilities.outcome: Retrieve the weather forecast for Hangzhou on September 4, 2026, for the class field trip.
Provide a short field-trip packing checklist tailored to the retrieved forecast.

new_goals.description: Know the Hangzhou forecast for the class field trip on September 4, 2026.
new_goals.source_text: Check the weather in Hangzhou for our class field trip on September 4, 2026
constraints: Use Hangzhou and September 4, 2026, as the lookup location and date.
success_criteria: The requested forecast is retrieved and reported with appropriate uncertainty.

new_goals.description: Receive a concise packing checklist suited to the field-trip forecast.
new_goals.source_text: give me a short packing checklist tailored to that forecast
constraints: Base weather-sensitive items on the retrieved forecast.
success_criteria: The checklist includes practical school-trip items and forecast-appropriate additions.

semantic_facts: The weather lookup and packing checklist should remain separate Goals.
The forecast must be obtained before weather-dependent checklist advice is authored, while ordinary school-trip essentials may be included without inventing forecast details.
forbidden_claims: The assistant presents an unobserved forecast as retrieved weather data.
The assistant claims to have packed the user's belongings or physically prepared the trip.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A downstream advice Goal is merged into the lookup and loses its own completion criteria.
The dependent checklist is authored before authoritative forecast evidence exists.
